{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''TT-109''''' was an [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]].

The shuttle was carrying personal to [[RS-32]] but was destroyed by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who was assigned to [[Battle of RS-32|disable]] the platform as it carried [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|Mag Pulse]] technology.
